classification.classification_reason: The article is about a reshuffle of senior IPS officers in Telangana, focusing on the new appointments and their backgrounds.

content.title: IPS officers behind major investigations, policing reforms take charge of key posts in Telangana
content.caption: The reshuffle brings officers associated with the Tollywood drugs investigation, the Disha case, the EAMCET paper leak probe, anti-Maoist operations and the creation of SHE Teams into key leadership positions across Telangana’s police establishment.
